notes.title: Remix Mode is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, friends!

You read that right, Remix Mode is [b]OUT NOW[/b] as a [b]free update[/b]! This is a BIG ONE so if you've been craving an excuse to jump back in to Tactical Takedown like I'm craving a cheese pizza, now's your time!

Remix Mode brings with it...[/p][list][*][p][b]More Variety[/b] - More than DOUBLE the enemy types -- introducing new ways to approach each level. (I saw a Bruiser rock up with an air conditioner ready to chuck at me and an Elite Foot oozing with new powers?!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Higher Difficulty[/b]  -  Strategies that work in the main game may not work in Remix Mode (I love kicking everyone off the edge of the game board, who doesn’t? I was SHOCKED to find there are breakable barricades stopping you and sturdy enemies who just stand there when you kick them, mocking your whole strat!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Build Crafting[/b] - You'll need to perfect your Turtle's loadout, by making the most of every move you purchased from Fugitoid. (You can also make it even more difficult for yourself if you want things even more challenging!)[/p][/*][/list][p]As we mentioned before, [b]this isn't a new game+ mode[/b], so if this is your first time playing Tactical Takedown you will be able to jump into Remix Mode as soon as you finish a chapter! So will anyone else, actually. I wrote that like it's only for new players, it's not! It's for everyone! Sorry, I'm just dragging this apology out now. Erm, hey, look at this video![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="aOjavINypzY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
The team here at Strange Scaffold have poured everything into this update, and we [b]couldn't have done it without your support[/b]. Thank you all so much for believing in our vision of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and most of all [b]thank you for your feedback[/b]! it's that feedback that has shaped this update.  [/p][p][/p][p]See you on the internet, [/p][p][/p][p] - Chris @ Strange Scaffold.[/p]

notes.title: Introducing REMIX MODE!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Turtles Fans!

You’ve given us a ton of feedback about Tactical Takedown -- what you love, and what you want more of. We’ve gone full Turtle with this, don’t get it twisted. What was that sound on the rooftop? Us, listening in on your desire for “more difficult”. Hear something like someone eating pizza in a sewer? Well, that was us n’all, listening as you tell a friend “they’ve gotta add more enemy types!” 

While us being on your roof isn’t true (sorry), what is true is Remix Mode! An update that will add three key things we’ve seen people asking for.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]More Variety[/b] - More than DOUBLE the enemy types -- introducing new ways to approach each level. ([i]I saw a Bruiser rock up with an air conditioner ready to chuck at me and an Elite Foot oozing with new powers?![/i])[/p][/*][*][p][b]Higher Difficulty[/b]  -  Strategies that work in the main game may not work in Remix Mode ([i]I love kicking everyone off the edge of the game board, who doesn’t? I was SHOCKED to find there are breakable barricades stopping you and sturdy enemies who just stand there when you kick them, mocking your whole strat![/i])[/p][/*][*][p][b]Build Crafting[/b] - You'll need to perfect your Turtle's loadout, by making the most of every move you purchased from Fugitoid. ([i]You can also make it even more difficult for yourself if you want things even more challenging![/i])[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Now, this isn’t a New Game+ Mode -- once you finish a chapter, its Remixed variant unlocks right away. So, if this is your first time playing Tactical Takedown, you don’t have to wait until the end of the game to ramp things up.[/p][p]
And I hear you, you’re asking “Is this paid DLC? I’ve got a pizza with marshmallows and anchovies to order!” Well get calling that pizza joint now because all of this will be included as a [b]free update[/b]. Xbox and Nintendo Switch versions will launch with Remix Mode right away. I’d say we’re too good to you, but it’s your feedback and support that have enabled us to make Remix Mode so we hope you enjoy it as much as we have making it![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="0prD_mVl45g;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
We can’t wait to show you more when Remix Mode launches [b]August 14th 2025.[/b]

See you on the internet,

Chris @ Strange Scaffold[/p]

notes.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown (PC) Review
notes.content:
I think out of all the games I could have possibly imagined, I never would have expected something like Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown. For a series so defined in almost every medium by action, seeing the half-shell heroes in a Turn-Based Strategy game seemed like a massive departure from what they’re best at. But if the turn-based formula could be applied to something like Metal Slug, then surely it could work for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

Much like with Metal Slug Tactics, I was a little skeptical at first, but once I started playing it, I was genuinely in awe of how well it worked. Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown not only works as a solid Turn-Based Strategy game, but also proves there’s so much that can be done with the genre to make it interesting and fun.

notes.title: Welcome to Tactical Takedown!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

It’s been a week, and we still can’t quite believe this game has gone from only a very small team knowing about it to everyone knowing about it! Our team has been working on this game for a long time now, and we are incredibly excited to see the reception the game has received.

[previewyoutube=WWicTR3TuJU;full][/previewyoutube]

We wanted to say [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all of you! Since our reveal at the PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted, we’ve had a ton of feedback and passion headed our way. We know how big this franchise is, and the opportunity to create our little part of it is a humbling and exciting prospect. 

We can’t wait to share more of the game with you, and you’re already in the right place for big updates. You can also check out our [url=https://discord.gg/dog-airport-game]Discord[/url] and our social channels for other little updates as we have them. 

For now, see you on the Internet! 

- Strange Scaffold
